Want something kawaii? 🫶 Want something metali? 🔥 Both came alive through the one and only @BABYMETAL_JAPAN last night! 💥

Huge thanks to all the metalheads who came from all over the country (and beyond!) to make this night unforgettable. 🙌 And to @metalverseworld, who kicked things off with a bang. 👏

And BABYMETAL, you were truly worth the wait. 🎉 Years of hoping and dreaming led to this explosive moment. Thank you for making Manila roar! ❤️‍🔥🦊
